review.why: Plans migrations from existing VPN, web gateway or SASE products to Cloudflare One, with policy mapping, parity gaps and staged rollout.
review.summary: Seven steps: identify the source stack, request structured exports, build an inventory, produce a mapping plan with confidence and manual decisions, create dependencies first, stage with disabled or audit-mode rules and pilots, and account for every source rule as migrated or explicitly not migrated. It lists exports to request and mapping traps for Zscaler and Palo Alto sources.
strengths: Every source rule must map to an object or a not-migrated row with security impact
Staged by default: audit mode and pilot groups
Source-specific traps such as warn actions with no direct equivalent
cautions: Vendor export formats and product features change
Later traps were not read in full
